نستعطي (form X)
# نَسْتَعْطِي (nastaʕṭī) /nas.taʕ.tˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
# نَسْتَعْطِيَ (nastaʕṭiya) /nas.taʕ.tˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
